assets.name: Sample Widget
assets.summary: A test asset proving extension assets merge into the catalogue and resolve an icon bundled with the extension.

abilities.text: While the Sample extension is enabled, this asset — and its bundled sample-widget icon (shipped in extensions/sample/icons/) — appear in the Asset picker.
Disable the extension and this asset, its icon, the Sample move, the Sample – Gizmo oracle, and the Test Golem all filter out cleanly — no code changed anywhere.
